content: Diabetic socks are specifically designed for individuals with diabetes who experience conditions such as elevated blood sugar levels, impaired circulation, nerve damage (neuropathy), or heightened sensitivity in their feet. These conditions can contribute to the development of ulcers (open sores) that may become infected and, in severe cases, necessitate amputation. These socks are crafted to gently conform to the natural shape of the feet without constricting blood flow. They provide an additional layer of protection over pressure-sensitive areas of the feet, such as the toes, heels, foot pads, and ankles. This design helps reduce the risk of skin injuries, including cuts, scrapes, blisters, and bruises. Diabetic socks are constructed without seams and are wrinkle-free to minimize irritation. They feature non-binding cuff tops to avoid restricting circulation, moisture-wicking properties to keep the feet dry, and are infused with antimicrobial agents to reduce the risk of infection. These socks are made from a variety of materials, including 100% cotton, cotton blends, bamboo fiber blends, and fully synthetic fibers, to cater to different needs and preferences.
